## 分诊定级(R+69):**晋级 `pm:queue`** · `domain:devx` · `tooling` · `priority:p2` · type `Task`

`finding` 摘除(定级即离标)。落点 `scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` 的 `indexFunctionBodies`。

**为什么晋级而不是关闭**(与本轮关掉的零活例卡的分界):今天代价是 **0**,但卡把理由说清了 ——

> **The mechanism itself has no safe direction.** 一个只有*部分*同名 body 会读的碰撞,要么**发明一个 seam**(不安全方向 —— 分母里的假成员),要么**丢掉一个真的**,而**输出里没有任何东西能把这两种情况与一次正确解析区分开**。

⇒ 与 #13430(零活例 + 盲区已自宣为显式非目标 ⇒ 关闭)不同:这里**没有任何声明承认过这个盲区**,而且当前的正确性是**靠运气**——卡实测三个 `lookup` body **都**经 `this.engine.findOne` 读 `sys_metadata`,所以两个 seam 在**任意一种解析下**都成立。⛔ 「碰巧对」不是不变量。

## ⚠️ 卡点名的兄弟卡 **#13456 现在返回 HTTP 404**

卡写:*"#13456 records the **same defect class in the sibling instrument** … very likely the same remedy shape, and **they should be read together**."* 并说其建议的修法(**按调用点的词法作用域链解析,而非扁平索引,再用一条回归对照钉住**)在本卡**原样适用**。

**现验:#13456 → 404。** ⇒ 那张卡**读不到了**,「一起读」这条指令**今天无法执行**。

⭐ 这是本会话第 **三** 个同形实例(#13178 · #12924 · #13456),全部归 **#13634**(*被停用的账号带走 issue 与评论,而没有任何东西检测遗留的悬空引用*)。已在 #13634 汇总。

⇒ **对本卡的实际影响**:兄弟卡的修法建议**已被本卡正文完整转述**(词法作用域链 + 回归对照),所以**没有丢失**——但 ⛔ 派发时**不要指望能打开 #13456**,也 ⛔ 不要把它当作可核验的引用。若 dev 想做成一次修两处,**落点自己去 `scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs` 上现读**,⛔ 不依赖那张卡。

## 范围

- 修法方向(继承自 #13456,已在本卡正文留档):**按调用点的词法作用域链解析**,取代 `byName.set(name, body)` 的扁平 last-wins 索引;**同笔加一条回归对照**(同文件多个同名 body,断言解析到词法上正确的那个);
- ⛔ **不得改 `contradictsWrapperResolution`** —— 卡已论证该守卫**在做它该做的事**(它管的是**跨 receiver 的名字碰撞**,不是单文件内同名 body 的碰撞),且两条子句在本例上**都正确通过**:callee 是裸标识符(其 docblock 有意接受),三个声明都恰好一个必需参数(arity 子句无可反驳)。收紧任一子句都够不到本例。

## ⭐ 一条要带进 `MAX_READ_WRAPPER_DEPTH` 决策的读数

卡指出:**爆炸半径随深度上界增长** —— 每多一跳 wrapper,就多一个必须唯一的名字。该碰撞**在第 3 跳就出现**,而上界今天是 **2**,所以它只在深度探测面里可达。⇒ 这是一条**反对抬高该上界的实测论据**,已记在 PR #13472 的门头里;本卡是它的独立留档,**免得它只活在一段讲别的事的注释里**。

## Claim + Dispatch — R34

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`. Branch: **`claude/issue-13474-lexical-scope-wrapper-resolution`**

**Serialisation**: ⛔ no hold. No in-flight card declares
`scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` or `scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs`.
⚠️ Three cards in flight sit on other `scripts/**` files — `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (#13448) and
`scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs` (#13471). ⛔ Neither is yours.

### Zone 1 — TRIAGE RULING(⛔ 不可重裁,照抄不译)

> **晋级 `pm:queue`** · `domain:devx` · `tooling` · `priority:p2` · type `Task`。落点
> `scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` 的 `indexFunctionBodies`。
>
> **为什么晋级而不是关闭**:今天代价是 **0**,但卡把理由说清了 ——
> > **The mechanism itself has no safe direction.** 一个只有*部分*同名 body 会读的碰撞,要么**发明一个
> > seam**(不安全方向 —— 分母里的假成员),要么**丢掉一个真的**,而**输出里没有任何东西能把这两种情况与
> > 一次正确解析区分开**。
>
> ⇒ 这里**没有任何声明承认过这个盲区**,而且当前的正确性是**靠运气** —— 三个 `lookup` body **都**经
> `this.engine.findOne` 读 `sys_metadata`,所以两个 seam 在**任意一种解析下**都成立。⛔「碰巧对」不是不变量。
>
> **范围**:修法方向 **按调用点的词法作用域链解析**,取代 `byName.set(name, body)` 的扁平 last-wins 索引;
> **同笔加一条回归对照**(同文件多个同名 body,断言解析到词法上正确的那个)。
> ⛔ **不得改 `contradictsWrapperResolution`** —— 卡已论证该守卫**在做它该做的事**。

### ⚠️ 兄弟卡 #13456 读不到,我复核过了 —— 但你不需要它

triage 说 #13456 返回 404。**我实测确认**:`#13456 → HTTP 404`、`#13178 → 404`、`#12924 → 404`,
而对照 `#13634 → HTTP 200`(⇒ 不是我的通道坏了,是那三张卡真的没了)。它们是被停用账号带走的悬空引用类,
汇总在 **#13634**。⭐ **但兄弟卡的修法建议已被本卡正文完整转述**(词法作用域链 + 回归对照)⇒ 没有信息丢失。
⛔ 派发时**不要试图打开 #13456**,也 ⛔ 不要把它当可核验引用。若你想一次修两处,`scripts/measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs`
**自己现读**,⛔ 不依赖那张卡。

### Zone 2 — PM 机制假设(⚠️ 须实测;⭐ 我量了三样,⛔ 都不是裁决)

- **A2.1 — ⚠️ 卡里的行号已经漂了,⛔ 不要照抄。** 卡写三个 `lookup` 在 `6657 / 6717 / 7129`;我在今天的
  `origin/main` 上量到 **6788 / 6848 / 7260** —— 文件动了约 131 行。同理那个调用点(卡写 `protocol.ts:6674`)
  也不在原位。⭐ **按字符串锚定,⛔ 不按行号**(今天已经有第二张卡栽在这上面)。先在你自己的 ref 上把三个声明和
  那个调用点重新定位,并把定位命令写进 PR。
- **A2.2 — 扁平索引确认存在,且不止一处。** `byName.set(...)` 在
  `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` 里出现在 **4 个位置**(:2127 / :2348 / :2350 / :2358)。⇒ 「换成
  词法作用域链」不是改一行。⚠️ 四处是否都要改、还是只有 wrapper hop 那条路径读的那几处要改,是你要测的 ——
  **改多了和改少了一样危险**,因为这个机制**没有安全方向**。
- **A2.3 — 我假设「今天 0 个 seam 受影响」仍然成立,⛔ 没有重测。** 卡的 0 是在 `71627f7b4e` 上量的,而文件已
  漂移。⚠️ **先重测这个 0**:若今天已经有 seam 受影响,那是比本卡大得多的发现,⛔ 立即报告而不是顺手修掉。
  ⭐ 而且这个 0 是**运气**不是构造 —— 三个 body 碰巧都读同一张表 —— 所以它随时会变。
- **A2.4 — 回归对照是交付物,不是附赠。** 裁决点名要「同文件多个同名 body,断言解析到词法上正确的那个」。
  ⚠️ 关键在于这条对照**必须在修复被抽掉时变红**,而且要红在**正确的方向**上(解析到了词法错误的那个),
  ⛔ 不是「随便改点什么就红」。反向验证时把这一点证出来。
- **A2.5 — ⛔ 不要顺手去修 `contradictsWrapperResolution`。** 卡已论证它对本例的两个判据(receiver、必需参数
  个数)**都正确通过**,因为三个声明都是单参数 async 箭头、callee 是裸标识符(该谓词**故意**接受裸标识符)。
  ⇒ 那个守卫做的是 name collision 之外的事。改它是扩大战场。

### Zone 3 — 建议路线(可选,⛔ 不是指令)

这个仓里已经有大量「用 TypeScript AST 而不是正则」的先例(`validate-hook-body-writes.ts` 的 pattern
reconciliation、`affected-docs.mjs` 的 `declarationChainAt`)。⭐ 尤其 `declarationChainAt` 做的正是「从一个位置
往外走词法链」这件事 —— 照抄本仓已有形制比发明新的便宜,也更容易让复核者相信。

### Standing constraints

⛔ Worktree-first。⛔ Never `git stash`。⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/`。⛔ Governed surface
(`docs/adr/**`、`.claude/**`、`skills/**`、`AGENTS.md`、`CLAUDE.md`)—— 停手并报告。⛔ 不改
`packages/spec/src/**`;⛔ 不改 `packages/metadata-protocol/**`(那只是被扫描的语料,不是修法落点)。
⛔ 不碰 `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`(#13448 在飞)与 `scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs`(#13471 在飞)。
`scripts/` 不发版 ⇒ `skip-changeset`,但**先查 `Check Changeset` 的实际结论**再贴标签。改门禁脚本会同时触发该约定
的义务与路径推导族 —— **两边都跑**。逐项按 GREEN / RED / NOT MEASURED 报告你**实际看到的退出码**(⛔ 不经管道取)。
restore 用**观察到的状态**证明,⛔ 不用退出码。

## ACCEPT — PR #13784, and a RULING on the docblock question

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`. R34.

### RULING: **B** — a one-sentence follow-up, and I have filed it

The dev asked what to do about a sentence in `contradictsWrapperResolution`'s docblock that this
change makes stale (*"`functionBodies` is a flat, file-scoped index keyed by BARE NAME"*), given that
A2.5 and Zone 1 both fenced that guard off **by name**. Options were A (leave it, reconciled from the
other side), B (follow-up docs-only PR), C (fix it here).

**B**, and the dev's reasoning is the ruling. ⛔ **Not C** — the prohibition was explicit and repeated,
and ⭐ *"a prohibition half-obeyed is worse than one obeyed and declared."* ⛔ **Not A alone** — the
reconciliation sits ~900 lines away and a reader landing on that docblock is simply told something
false, in a file whose whole discipline is that **a comment which no longer holds is a hazard, not
cosmetics**. Filed as a follow-up so it cannot be lost. ⭐ Flagging it rather than deciding it, on a
region fenced off by name, was exactly right.

### ⭐ And the header edit was RIGHT, which is the harder half of that same judgement

The dev **did** edit the file header, and said so plainly. I checked why: the header recorded this
collision as an **OPEN hazard in the present tense**, and supplied **the third of three reasons for
leaving `MAX_READ_WRAPPER_DEPTH` alone** — a maintainer-reserved bound. ⇒ Closing the hazard silently
would have left a **maintainer's decision resting on an argument that no longer holds**. ⛔ That is not
tidying, it is keeping a reserved decision honest. The note now states what closed it and what
survives in narrower form, and **the bound is not moved**.

### What I verified myself — including a check of my own that was too narrow

| claim | how I checked | result |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `contradictsWrapperResolution` untouched | extracted **docblock + body** from `origin/main` and from `d6cad4a65` and compared | ✅ **byte-identical, 8678 chars both** |
| `indexLogAliases` left flat *with the measurement written in* | same extraction | ✅ docblock 1748 → 2317, carrying *"across the whole scan surface this index holds ZERO same-file name collisions … Widening the key anyway would be an unmeasured change to a resolver whose errors have no safe direction, **which is the argument AGAINST making it, not for it**"* |

⚠️ My first extraction started at the `function` keyword and therefore **could not see docblock
changes** — it reported `indexLogAliases` as untouched and would have had me tell the dev its
measurement was missing. ⛔ Caught before writing it down. **Sixth ad-hoc instrument of mine to
mislead today**; the rule I keep re-learning is that a surprising result is a reason to suspect the
tool first.

### The design decisions, both measured rather than asserted

⭐ Two deliberate departures from a strict lexical resolver: a name with exactly **one** body still
resolves from anywhere (nothing to choose, and it preserves every hop the census depends on — ⇒ the
change is **confined to exactly the collisions**), and a name with **several** bodies and none
enclosing the call site is **REFUSED rather than guessed**.

**A2.1** confirmed and extended: the card's line numbers had drifted (6788/6848/7260, call site 6805
inside `findDraft` at 6786), anchored on strings with the locating commands in the PR — ⭐ **and
`protocol.ts` carries a SECOND collision the card never named**, `findOverlay` (6843/7257), fixed by
the same change. **A2.2** answered by measurement: 3 of the 4 `byName.set` sites change; the 4th is a
different index, instrumented over the whole scan surface at **zero collisions**, so it is left flat
⭐ **with the measurement replacing a now-false cross-reference** — over-fixing declined on evidence,
which is what that assumption asked for. **A2.3** re-measured at the merged head, ⛔ not quoted from
